svg.title: Yellow on Yellow
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Diagrammatic seam distinguishes same-colour panels.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-relief-paintings-05-2001/lightbox/works/yellow-on-yellow-2001-12575; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
